dispositions.justification: Studio clears its pairing and cleanup block only after the connection confirms revocation and owned workspace closure. Require an explicit owned-workspace revocation receipt. On a lost or invalid response, replay only the same revocation intent and keep source, observation and artifact effects unavailable.
